privilege.name: Patienthandover Privilege
privilege.description: Allows users to create and manage clinical handovers

privilege.name: Patient Handover: View
privilege.description: View handover dashboards, saved batches, SBAR, tasks, and transaction details

privilege.name: Patient Handover: Create
privilege.description: Create and submit patient handover batches

privilege.name: Patient Handover: Receive
privilege.description: Acknowledge assigned handover batches as received

privilege.name: Patient Handover: Complete Tasks
privilege.description: Complete tasks transferred in a patient handover

privilege.name: Patient Handover: Export Reports
privilege.description: Export patient handover reports containing clinical information

privilege.name: Patient Handover: View All Providers
privilege.description: View handovers assigned to other providers at the current location

privilege.name: Patient Handover: Cancel
privilege.description: Cancel a pending patient or emergency trolley handover with a recorded reason

privilege.name: Patient Handover: Edit
privilege.description: Edit an individual patient or trolley item in a pending handover with a recorded reason

globalProperty.description: Hours before a pending handover batch is shown as overdue.
Optional comma-separated location IDs allowed to use Laboratory Handover when their names do not contain Laboratory or Lab.
When true, empty Situation/Background/Assessment/Recommendation boxes on Make Handover are pre-filled from the patient's recent observations (or last handover) for the user to review.

Hours an unsent Make Patient Handover draft is kept without changes. A draft lives only in the open browser tab, so entries are not lost while moving between worklist pages; it is also removed by a page refresh, a new tab or browser, submission or Discard draft. Text pre-filled from records is never stored in a draft; it is always recalculated.
0 = pre-fill SBAR with the latest saved value of each configured concept, whatever its age (its date is shown). Set a number of days to ignore older values.

Concepts used to pre-fill Situation. Positions are comma-separated; alternatives joined with | share one line and only the one created last is shown (on equal times the first listed). Default: chief complaints or progress-note subjective (progress_subject); subjective only when created after the chief complaints.
Concepts used to pre-fill Background. Default: clinical summary (Clinican notes), history of present illness, past medical history (PREVIOUS MEDICAL HISTORY), known allergies (ALLERGY COMMENT).

Concepts used to pre-fill Assessment. ABNORMAL_LABS marks where abnormal laboratory results are listed and DIAGNOSES where all other diagnosis data (coded answers of class Diagnosis, or text in fields named diagnosis) is listed. Default: progress-note assessment (progress_assessment), progress-note objective (progress_objective), latest vital signs, abnormal lab results, other diagnosis, other presumptive diagnosis, final diagnosis.

Concepts used to pre-fill Recommendation. Default: investigation summary (admission TREATMENT PLAN OTHER REMARKS) or plan (progress_plan, shown only when created after the investigation summary), treatment/action taken (PROGRESS NOTE, INVESTIGATION/TREATMENT), health education needs.

Comma-separated encounter type UUIDs of admission forms. SBAR pre-fill only uses values created after the patient's admission time: the latest of the active visit start, the latest of these admission encounters, and the start of the current stretch of care (see patienthandover.sbar.episodeGapHours).

A gap longer than this many hours between two encounters means the patient left and came back: the last stay then starts at the first encounter after the gap. Protects against visits that were never closed. Today's date is not used: values entered after the last admission are always pre-filled, however long ago it was.
